tools.name: send_postcard
tools.description: Use when someone wants postcards made or sent from a photo, to one person or many. Creates an unpaid order with one postcard per recipient, each with an optional note, and returns a link where the person reviews every card and address and pays; it never charges money or mails anything. Mailed from t

tools.name: send_letter
tools.description: Use when someone wants a letter printed and mailed, to one person or many. Creates an unpaid order with one letter per recipient from the text, optionally with a photo and, within the US, as certified mail, and returns a link where the person reviews every letter and address and pays; it never charg

tools.name: show_order
tools.description: Use when an existing order or postcard draft needs its button shown again, or to see whether it was paid and mailed. Reads the order fresh from its link and shows its pieces, total, status and button. Creates nothing, and never charges money or mails anything.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "send_postcard" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when someone wants a postcard made or sent from a photo. Creates an unpaid draft from one photo, with an optional note and recipient address, and returns a link to it; it never charges money or mails a postcard. The person finishes the note and address and pays on the website: $5 with postage in" → after: "Use when someone wants postcards made or sent from a photo, to one person or many. Creates an unpaid order with one postcard per recipient, each with an optional note, and returns a link where the person reviews every card and address and pays; it never charges money or mails anything. Mailed from t"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "show_postcard" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
